findings.title: Background cites a publication that the saved prior art records as fictional
findings.attack: [0007] describes 'US2019/0123456A1'. The prior-art index lists that number only as requester item S1, marked as a fictional test reference that was never fetched. If a real document of that number exists, the description misstates it: a US duty-of-candour problem (37 CFR 1.56) and, at the EPO and UK, an admission that the listed features were known. Must be corrected before filing.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Delete [0007], or rewrite it without a publication number only if the inventor or counsel confirms the approaches are known. Recheck [0013] afterwards.

findings.title: Drawn captions call FIGS. 10, 11A-11C, 12A-12B and 13A candidate constructions shown for disclosure of the genus only
findings.attack: The figure instructions require captions on the sheets such as 'Candidate alternative seat-ring geometries; not built or tested; shown for disclosure of the genus only' and 'retained pending confirmation'. A drawing stating that the construction is a candidate pending confirmation invites a US written-description attack on possession of claims 26, 40-44, 66 and 67 and gives an opponent a quotation against reliance on those figures.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Remove 'Candidate', 'shown for disclosure of the genus only' and 'pending confirmation' from the drawn captions; keep the description's plain statements that no test was made. The human confirms conception at the gate; unconfirmed embodiments and their claims come out rather than being filed as candidates.

findings.title: Outward movement of the wall is said to open a gap to the surrounding bore in which the ring is interference fitted
findings.attack: Radial expansion is an outward movement of the wall, yet it is said to open a clearance between the wall and the bore around it, in which the ring is held with no clearance. The relief construction does not say how expansion breaks the closing line contact, and [0202] says it is not the tested construction, so the tested construction is undisclosed.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Add disclosure of the prototype construction at the outer surface of the seat ring: extent of the fit, clearance at rest, closing line, how expansion unseats it, entry and exit of the purge flow. No claim narrowing.

findings.title: Point of application, direction and conversion of the axial load are not disclosed and are stated inconsistently
findings.attack: No paragraph says where on the seat ring the purge shoulder bears, in which direction, or what reacts the load; [0113] places the load at the sealing edge, which the poppet has left in over-travel. [0134] and [0170] say the convolution flattens, [0172] says the bow increases, and [0237] derives a 0.15 mm gap from flattening a 0.12 mm convolution.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Add disclosure from the prototype record of the contact surface, load direction, stress state of the wall and sense of each convolution; reconcile [0113], [0134], [0170], [0172] and [0237]. No claim narrowing.

findings.title: The axial load path through the seat ring is not described consistently
findings.attack: The load point, the reaction and the direction of wall movement are not stated, and the text conflicts: [0113] loads the upper (sealing) edge, FIG. 2 instructions load the fit-band end, [0167]/[0186] put the fit band at the end opposite the sealing edge, FIG. 1 instructions put both at the tyre-chamber end, and [0116] has the poppet moving away from the sealing edge. [0134], [0237] and claim 22 say the convolution flattens under the axial load, while [0172] says the equivalent bow increases under the same load. An examiner has a verifiable internal contradiction to raise sufficiency (EPO) and enablement/written description (US) against the principal embodiment.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Add one paragraph from the built prototype stating which end of the seat ring faces the tyre chamber, where the purge shoulder bears, what surface of the core body reacts the load and how the convoluted wall moves; conform [0113], [0134], [0237], FIG. 1 and FIG. 2 instructions and claim 22. No claim narrowing needed.

findings.title: Two-piece seat has no disclosed purge gap although claim 1 reaches it through reference signs 142 and 146
findings.attack: Numeral 146 is absent from the description. The two-piece seat paragraphs and Statement 7.1 describe outward deflection and wiping only; no flow path, location, closed state or distinction from the main passage is stated.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Add to [0181]-[0183] and Statement 7.1 the purge gap 146, its boundaries, closed state at rest and flow path; then add a dependent claim to the two-piece seat.

findings.title: Claim 2 omits the pump head and pressure differential present in every description of the method
findings.attack: Every description of the method couples and removes a pump head and applies a pressure differential; no other way of moving the poppet is described and [0090] defines the inflation cycle by a pump head.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Add a paragraph and claim-support statement in the terms of claim 2, with any other means of moving the poppet the inventor conceived; revise [0090].

findings.title: Claim 24 dependent on claim 22 combines two contradictory statements
findings.attack: Claim 24 ('a single outward bow') may depend on claim 22 ('the axial load flattens the at least one convolution'); [0172] says 'The bow increases under axial load'. The combination is contradicted by the description.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Make claim 24 depend on claim 21 only, unless F-28-1 is resolved in a way that reconciles the two.

findings.title: Claim 4 claims shape-setting alone; every method passage includes laser cutting and quenching
findings.attack: Claim 4: 'shape-setting (512) the seat ring in a fixture that holds the load-converting geometry'. [0022], [0252] and statement 5.1 always present laser cutting, shape-setting and quenching together; standalone shape-setting appears only in the definition [0098].
findings.least_narrowing_action: Add a sentence that the NiTi seat ring may be made by a method comprising the shape-setting, the other FIG. 7 steps being optional.

findings.title: Claim 79 laser cutting to a profile of the convoluted wall is not explained and conflicts with [0170] and [0254]
findings.attack: Claim 79: 'the laser cutting cuts the seat ring to a profile of the convoluted wall'. The convolution is a wave in the wall section; [0170] and [0254] say it is pressed in the shape-setting fixture and laser cutting only trims the ends. How a laser produces a sectional wave is not described.
findings.least_narrowing_action: State in [0253] what 'profile' means (for example the axial outline of the blank), or delete claim 79.

findings.title: Claimed combinations fall outside the combinations the description permits
findings.attack: [0035] and [0349] confine combinations to those set out under Combinations. Polymer seat ring with fit band and relief, polymer seat ring with hard-anodised sealing face, fit band without relief, and purge gap width for other elements are not set out.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Replace the closed wording of [0035] and [0349] with an open statement and add the specific combinations claimed.

findings.title: FIG. 1 instructions place the main passage against the core body bore
findings.attack: FIG. 1 instructions draw 'the main passage (26) as the annular flow path between the poppet (40) and the core body bore (22)', whereas [0123] and [0126] put it between the sealing edge and the sealing face, and the purge gap is bounded by the core body bore. The drawing blurs the distinction on which claim 1 rests.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Change the FIG. 1 instruction so that the lead line for 26 ends at the path between the sealing face 42 and the sealing edge 32.

findings.title: FIG. 13A and numerals 146 and 220 have no description
findings.attack: The figure plan and instructions include FIG. 13A (Schrader-pattern core body 220) and the registry lists 146 and 220; the brief description lists FIG. 13B alone and neither FIG. 13A, 146 nor 220 appears in the description. Claim 1 uses 146. Formal objections under EPO Rules 42(1)(d) and 46(2)(i) and 37 CFR 1.74 and 1.84(p)(5).
findings.least_narrowing_action: Describe FIG. 13A and purge gap 146, or remove FIG. 13A, renumber FIG. 13B as FIG. 13 and remove 146 and 220 from claims and registry.

findings.title: Figure files are instructions, carry drafting-process statements and number items the description does not describe
findings.attack: No drawing exists. The figure plan records FIGS. 11, 12 and 13A as not stated in the inventor's disclosure and the captions call them candidates, while the description calls them embodiments. Numerals 146, 220, 402, 404 and FIG. 13A are absent from the description.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Remove the drafting-process statements and captions; describe or remove FIG. 13A and numerals 146, 220, 402 and 404.

findings.title: Purge gap and closed state at rest not disclosed for the slotted sleeve, split seat ring and tapered seat ring
findings.attack: The slots of the slotted sleeve exist at rest and nothing closes them; the split seat ring paragraph does not identify the purge gap; the tapered seat ring paragraph describes none. None says where the sealing edge is.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Add for each form the location of the purge gap, what closes it at rest and where the sealing edge is.

findings.title: Ranges and prototype values generalised from the seat ring to every radially deflectable element
findings.attack: Claims 19 ('a purge gap width of from 0.10 mm to 0.25 mm'), 33 and 34 depend on claim 1 without the seat ring. [0236] and [0237] state the ranges for the purge shoulder bearing on the seat ring 30 and for purge gap 60 opened by flattening of convolution 36; statement 1.23 attaches them only to the seat ring. No disclosure with the wiper ring, slotted sleeve, split or tapered seat ring; amendment of claim 1 with these ranges alone would be an intermediate generalisation.
findings.least_narrowing_action: If the inventor agrees, add a sentence that these ranges apply to each form of the radially deflectable element; otherwise make claims 19, 33 and 34 depend on claim 20, giving up the ranges for the other forms.

findings.title: Slotted sleeve, split seat ring and tapered seat ring: no closed-at-rest purge gap and no seal at rest described
findings.attack: Claim 1 requires a purge gap 'closed at rest and throughout the normal stroke' and a sealing face seated on a sealing edge. [0176] calls the axial slots a purge route when spread but never says they are closed at rest or whether the sleeve carries the sealing edge; [0177] does not say which path is the purge gap; [0178] says nothing of the purge gap or seal. The combination rests only on the general statement at [0163].
findings.least_narrowing_action: For each form add one sentence stating where the sealing edge is, which path is the purge gap and what closes it at rest and through the normal stroke, if within the inventor's conception.

findings.title: Snap-back wipe across the sealing face is claimed at a time when the sealing face is spaced from the seat ring
findings.attack: [0137] puts the shape recovery before the return through the normal stroke, so the sealing face is 0.6 mm from the sealing edge when the wipe is said to occur; [0138] offers the wipe as a belief. Claims 32 and 76 extend it to polymer seat rings, beyond Statement 1.20.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Add the inventor's account of when and where contact occurs; meanwhile restrict claims 32 and 76 to the superelastic seat ring claims, giving up a wipe claim for polymer seat rings.

findings.title: The snap-back wipe cannot occur in the sequence the description gives
findings.attack: Claims recite 'the seat ring moves across the sealing face of the poppet in a snap-back wipe'. [0137] has the seat ring recover and the purge gap close before 'The poppet 40 then returns through the normal stroke 114 and the sealing face 42 seats again', so the sealing face is at least a normal stroke away when the ring recovers. [0138] states the mechanism only as a belief.
findings.least_narrowing_action: State from the inventor's observation what surface the recovering seat ring moves across and when the sealing face contacts it; or recast claims 32, 56 and 76 to shape recovery of a superelastic seat ring on removal of the axial load.

findings.title: Two-piece seat: purge gap 146 and the route of the purge shoulder to the wiper ring are not described
findings.attack: Claim 1 recites 'a purge gap (60, 146)' and 'a sealing edge (32, 132, 142)'. Numeral 146 does not occur in the description; [0181]-[0183] and [0293]-[0295] never say the wiper ring deflection opens a purge gap, where it lies or that it is distinct from the main passage, nor how a purge shoulder below the sealing face reaches a wiper ring below the rigid seat.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Add to [0182] the location of purge gap 146, that it is distinct from the main passage 26, and the path by which the purge shoulder reaches the wiper ring.

findings.title: Claim 2 recites closing of the purge gap without the shape recovery the description pairs with it
findings.attack: Claim 2: 'so that the axial load is removed and the purge gap closes'. Every passage states the closing is by shape recovery; claim 2 is broader, a support weakness if read to cover closing by other means.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Add a sentence that the purge gap closes on removal of the axial load, by the shape recovery alone or assisted, for example by the garter spring of [0211].

findings.title: Claim 24 on claim 22 claims a bow that flattens where the description says it increases
findings.attack: [0172] says the bow increases under axial load; claim 22 requires the convolution to flatten.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Make claim 24 dependent on claim 21 only, or resolve under F-28-1.

findings.title: Claim 68 recites a convolution amplitude when it may depend on claim 3 alone
findings.attack: Claim 68 ('a convolution amplitude of from 0.08 mm to 0.20 mm') may depend on claim 3, which does not require a convolution; the load-converting geometry may be a strut pattern, helical slot or taper. Claim 69 likewise.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Make the convolution-amplitude alternative of claim 68 and all of claim 69 depend on claim 62.

findings.title: Claim 9 omits the stop and staggered engagement that produce the two rates
findings.attack: Series springs are disclosed with a stop and nested springs with staggered engagement; without them the arrangements give one rate.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Add a sentence that the stop and the staggered engagement are examples of means by which the second spring stage is engaged.

findings.title: Claims 12 and 34 isolate prototype values from the prototype
findings.attack: The values are disclosed as those of one built configuration, together with every other prototype value.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Add a sentence that each prototype value is disclosed independently of the others.

findings.title: Disclosed alternatives lie outside every claim, one by the description's own statement
findings.attack: [0179] describes a disc spring that opens a purge gap and says its deflection is not a radial expansion, which tells a competitor how to avoid claim 1. The detent and spring-loaded stop are outside claim 6. Unclaimed disclosed subject matter is dedicated to the public in the United States.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Add a generic claim to a deflectable element whose deflection opens the purge gap, with claim-support statements and a figure, and a generic term for the threshold-separating return arrangement. Nothing is given up.

findings.title: Two-piece seat cannot serve as a fallback because its purge gap is not described
findings.attack: An amendment to the rigid seat and wiper ring must state that the wiper ring's deflection opens the purge gap; the description says only that it deflects outward and wipes. The amendment would be refused as not directly and unambiguously disclosed.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Add the purge gap 146 to the two-piece seat paragraphs and Statement 7.1: boundaries, closed state at rest, relation to the main passage, path of the air purge.

findings.title: Combination clause is closed
findings.attack: Features may be combined only in the combinations set out under Combinations, and [0217] lists six forms that exclude the slotted sleeve, split seat ring, tapered seat ring, collar, detent and wall slots.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Replace with an open statement and extend [0217] to every form of the radially deflectable element, load-applying surface and return bias.

findings.title: Example 1 does not state the convolution count, return-spring construction or purge-gap boundary of the tested cores
findings.attack: [0279] says only that the return spring 'had a two-rate characteristic' and the seat ring 'had a convoluted wall 34'. Without the number of convolutions, the spring construction and the purge-gap boundary of the tested cores, a fallback to the tested embodiment cannot be combined with any of those features without an intermediate generalisation, and the data cannot be tied to one or two convolutions.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Add to Example 1 the number of convolutions, the return-spring construction and the purge-gap boundary of P-1 to P-3, from the inventor's records.

findings.title: Fit band and free portion disclosed only with the relief, and tested construction not identified
findings.attack: The fit band, free portion and relief are introduced together; a claim to the first two against a plain bore is an intermediate generalisation, and [0202] disclaims the relief for the tested valve cores without saying what they had.
findings.least_narrowing_action: State whether the fit band and free portion are used with a plain core body bore, and state the construction of the tested valve cores.

findings.title: Parameters with a single value give no room to amend
findings.attack: The normal stroke, interference fit, composition, shape-setting conditions and austenite finish temperature each have one value or one bound; no relation between parameters is stated.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Ask the inventor for workable ranges, the method of determining the austenite finish temperature and any relation between dimensions; add them as candidates.

findings.title: The detent is not disclosed in combination with the other features as an alternative to the two-rate characteristic
findings.attack: Claim 6 requires 'a two-rate characteristic'; [0148] discloses a detent giving 'a step in force in place of a change of rate' once only, with no statement or combination. A detent design falls outside claim 6, and amending claim 1 to cover 'a two-rate characteristic or a detent' with the ranges, purge shoulder or seat ring draws an intermediate-generalisation objection.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Add a numbered statement for the detent on statement 1.3 and a sentence that the detent may replace the two-rate characteristic in each combination and with the ranges of [0238] and [0239].

findings.title: Wall-slot and valve-stem-bore arrangements too thinly described to carry an amendment
findings.attack: The wall slots are placed in a free portion and also combined with a fully retained outer surface. The valve-stem-bore arrangement is one sentence without a figure, and claim 47 excludes claim 45.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Describe the two wall-slot arrangements separately; add a figure and paragraph for the valve-stem-bore arrangement and extend claim 47 to claim 45.

findings.title: The annular purge gap bounded by the core body bore is described for the seat ring only
findings.attack: Claims 16-18 recite a purge gap 'bounded by an outer surface of the radially deflectable element and by a bore', 'a core body bore (22)', 'annular'. [0124] and [0185] describe the clearance for the seat ring 30 only; no passage describes it for the slotted sleeve, split seat ring, tapered seat ring or wiper ring, so an amendment path on a generic element lacks combination support.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Add one sentence that, for each form of the radially deflectable element whose outer surface faces the core body bore, the purge gap may be an annular clearance between them.

findings.title: The fit band and relief have no numbered combination, and none with the polymer seat ring
findings.attack: Claim 26: 'the interference fit acts on a fit band (35) ... a free portion (37) which ... expands into a core body bore relief (202)'. [0186] ties the fit band to the interference fit and locating shoulder; no statement combines them, and FIG. 8 instructions exclude the fit band from the polymer seat ring. Amendment taking the relief alone, or with claims 30-31, lacks basis.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Add a numbered statement combining seat ring, interference fit on a fit band next to the locating shoulder, free portion and core body bore relief, and state whether it applies to the polymer seat ring 130.
